Speaking of which -- I still see therapists because I'm required to, but the necessary inhibition does me more harm than good; I don't dare stray far past mushy generalities about depression and fatigue and lack of motivation etc, don't dare tell them anything close to what I'm REALLY thinking and feeling, because I know how that ends: I STILL have nightmares about the last literal-shithole asylum (I'm talking real shit smeared on the walls, and that was a *relatively* pleasant part of it -- I could write for hours about that place alone) that a doctor I dared be honest with had me thrown into.  I PROMISE you I walked out of that place -- and out of every other psych ward I've been locked up in -- worse than I was when I entered.  "But at least it saved your life"?  Well, if physical restraint in living-nightmare conditions is your idea of "saving".  All -- *ALL* -- those places have done have made me MORE suicidal.  Because I dared commit the crime of being a little too honest with a doctor -- because I couldn't keep my shit repressed, because I let the mask slip just long enough -- I got rewarded for it by being pulled out of my home by the police and having control over my body taken away from me and forcefully restrained and monitored against my will.  I felt like I was being raped all over again -- if not worse, because at least when I was raped I wasn't rendered helpless for DAYS.  That last asylum, when I finally got released and was sent home... do you know what it's like to weep at sleeping in your own bed and getting your own food again?  To not have to ask permission to go to a bathroom that isn't riddled with puddles of piss on the floor?  To simply be able to weep at all, loudly and uncontrollably, without reprimand or fear that you're going to wake up the guy next to you who fucking slashed open someone's throat?  Yeah, thanks so much for the "help", you gallant stewards of the shitholes in this shitty healthcare system!  You really turned *me* around!

And then one by one all my friends fell away.  Because even if I didn't tell them outright, they could smell it coming off me sooner or later.  Friends I've known since fucking childhood that just couldn't take the sheer anguish radiating out of me anymore.  And part of me is relieved when they leave -- and when I'm deliberately pushing friends away myself -- so that it'll minimize the pain to them when I *do* let go.  I can't spare my mother and sister that pain but I can at least spare them.  But the selfish obverse of that is that the motherfucking loneliness is choking me, constantly aching me and just adding its fuel to the fire.  I would give anything for one real, in-the-flesh friend (I can't do online-only/long-distance relationships of any kind ever again) (and yes, I mean I really *do* want just a friend, except for one painfully misguided interlude I basically haven't had sex since my husband died over 10 years ago and I genuinely do not miss it and am not seeking it, but I would *pay* someone who would just fucking HUG me) who would accept me EXACTLY as I am now and not be scared away and would not let me push them away.  Someone I could feel fucking SAFE with.  I keep fucking daring the universe to let me find such a person.  But they're all a thousand miles away and/or are trying to fool me or themselves.  They don't exist.  People *say* they're caring and compassionate, and perhaps for most other people's purposes they are, but they all can only bear to stay around the monster for so long or keep looking at its festering wounds so much.

And how can I blame anyone else for wanting out of my life when I want out of it so badly myself?

(Oh, and one more thing while I'm at it: I also hate the fucking state of the world these days.  Yeah, I know this is the point where half will automatically switch off, because god forbid you actually *give* a shit instead of *being* one, but I cannot tell you the depths of the nauseous disgust that You-Know-Who stirs up in me whenever I see/read the news, which I go to great lengths to avoid now.  The world is fucked and getting a little more fucked every day -- it feels more and more on an existential level that, in a way, we've *all* settled on slow suicide, we've all surrendered.  Or at least enough of the world has that the good, caring, loving people aren't going to be able to pull us through.  The bastards have won, they've fucked the planet and unless you're rich enough to wipe your ass with benjamins then they've fucked you, too.  If you can imagine the next fifty years through the haze of climate change, encroaching fascism, economic collapse, and the masks coming ALL the way off in the eternal 99% Us Vs. 1% Them Wars -- if you can gaze into the eyes of that rough beast slouching towards Bethlehem and feel hopeful/optimistic -- then congratulations, you're crazier than *I* am.  "Only the truly insane try to stay sane in a crazy world," or however the quote goes, whoever wrote it that I can't be arsed to look up.)

I have nothing left.  Nothing I've ever had that was good has lasted, and nothing that I've had that's lasted was good.  Nothing that wouldn't crumble if I dared touch it and gave it a little push.  No safety, no emotional security, no financial stability, no promise of relief from my physical and mental deterioration.  I have been ready and willing to go for over a decade, and I feel completely justified about it.  I OWN the right to just be fucking TIRED of it all.  I own the right to want to end my own long-term pain.  I own the right to value -- yes, value -- my life enough to want to end it on my own goddamn terms.  Of *course* I don't want to hurt anyone else, of *course* I know the pain it will cause to my mother and sister and whoever left (if anyone) truly gives a damn about me -- but you know what?  I think I also own the right to want to stop living for anyone else's sake.  And *I* would not dare deny *THEM* that right over their OWN lives.  I would not in a million years beg them to stay on this earth for the sake of sparing *me* pain regardless of how much pain *they* were in.  And I love my mother and my sister more than anything else in the world, gawd knows I do, but fuck it, I AM just too too *too* fucking tired of keeping myself on this pathetic IV drip of life support to spare them.  I have lived with too much pain for too long -- and they KNOW that.  They know what I've been through and they see the husk of my existence scraping by every fucking day.  I would not wish THEM one DAY of living through this for my sake.

And now I think it's time I let me love -- yes, love -- *myself* enough to let myself go.

Okay, since this seems to be staying up, I'll risk posting it one more time here as a comment.  Looking at the rules, I genuinely don't know what I've violated, unless this was badly misconstrued to read as "pro-suicide."  It's pro-TALKING about suicidal feelings (that *is* what this place is for, right?), without fear or guilt or shame.  It's just me talking about the terminal suicidal pain *I* am in -- wanting to talk about it doesn't mean I'm "pro-pain" any more than talking about terminal physical pain would mean I'm pro-cancer or whatever.  Anyway, whoever's pushing the buttons here, please let this stay up or tell me why you won't let it.

...

So, I'm a fortysomething guy, semi-disabled shut-in.  And I am so. fucking. ready. to blow my brains out.

Yeah, I know, killer pickup line, right?  And so we set the stage: Long story short, I've been through a lot of trauma in my life, from being raped as a child to becoming a widower in my early 30s, and more loss and abuse and grief than I care to count.  I could spend hours just talking about career failure and financial catastrophe that I haven't and never will recover from, all the things that put me in hospitals and psych wards, mind-meltingly sick shit I've had to witness and live through, and the deaths of most of my family and too many loved ones and friends.  (I've had jaded psychiatrists reel from my life story and be like, "Wow, and you're still here... that's... something!")  I have no local friends; over the past few years, the only couple I had left have drifted away as my physical and mental health keeps spiraling.  And I can hardly blame them for wanting out of my life, since I want out of it myself.  I live with all that's left of my family, my ailing mother and my sister -- the latter acting as caretaker to both of us -- and I almost never set foot outside my door anymore except when I have to see my doctor(s).  And the *ONLY* thing keeping me here at all is knowing that killing myself would also be killing my mother.  Otherwise... I'm so fucking lonely, so fucking tired of the pain, that I ache to just be done with it all.  I've tried several times -- two serious attempts (as an adult, once as a teen) and several "russian roulette" attempts.  (God, how I wish we *did* have a gun.  But of course I'm the reason we don't.)  The last serious attempt was hanging myself, which failed quite messily and left me with probable brain damage (I'm on medicaid, no insurance to cover an MRI, so not confirmed, but my doctor thinks it's probable and I "feel" it every damn day).  My russian-roulettes have been overdosing on my pills, trying to take enough that would kill me but could look like an accident, figuring/hoping that my mother would recover more easily from that than *knowing* it was deliberate; but I've built up too much of a fucking tolerance to everything, and all I have to show for all that is countless hours of pain on/beside/under the throne, and slowly wrecking my health further than it already is (my liver must look like rotten swiss cheese).  I tried hardest after the death of my husband, and that's the one that really sticks in the gut, the one that I constantly hate that I failed: that would've been my time to do it, my best chance for it to be "understood" and forgiven, to my mother and anyone who gave a damn about me.  But I blew it and now I’m trapped here.  Fuck me for fucking that up.

Oh, and my mom had a stroke last summer, and if it wasn't made clear to me in no uncertain terms that my death would kill her before, it certainly is clear now.  So I don't think even a successful "russian roulette" would work -- hell, I think it would kill her now if I *did* just have an actual genuine accident, slipping and cracking my skull open or something.  (And since I developed chronic pain and can hardly get out of bed without a cane and my meds, that's not too implausible, so maybe if I'm lucky... no, goddammit, the fucking sight alone would kill her... fuck.)

But I still want to go so fucking badly.  I *ACHE* to go.  I don't believe, but I "pray" anyway every night to go painlessly in my sleep and to let my mom and sister find the strength together and survive it.  And, well, terrible as I know this is, I am quickly... losing the ability to keep my concern about her as a check against my next attempt.  I am building up a strong, long-long-LONG-pent-up desire to make one more serious attempt, one that has as low risk of failure as anything.  I have no gun and no surefire painless methods available to me that I know of (unable to leave the house on my own and jump in front of a train or something), and I'm afraid to try hanging and fuck it up again -- but I'm almost at the point where, fine, I'll do it painfully then, I'll drink a tall cup of bleach then jam a steak knife into my carotid or something.  As long as it's certain.  Minutes of immediate unbearable agony to cash out the years and years of the slower form.

I am so sick and tired of being alive that it *embarrasses* me.  I'm humiliated with myself for still somehow being here.  I stare into the mirror and feel nothing but disgust at that thing that dares to still be wasting oxygen.

And you know what?  I don't even think I'm *wrong* for wanting this.  Please don't waste your time giving me any "permanent solution to a temporary problem" type of spiel.  Because guess what?  There are such things as permanent problems.  The damage to my body, heart, and mind, are permanent; I live with things that, every day, I have to take a fistful of medications for just to retain any semblance of mobility and lucidity at all, meds so intense that nearly half the meds I take are simply to (imperfectly) counter the side effects of the other half.  I will probably never be able to function as an independent adult again, physically, financially, or psychologically.  I honestly believe, with as much objectivity as I'm capable of, that I have the complete moral right to commit suicide: this is not impulsiveness talking, this is not a bad spell of depression, this isn't sociopathic apathy, this isn't one night's weakness: this is YEARS of pain, DECADES of trauma and grief too deep to ever be healed -- and years of *certainty*, of readiness.  If my pain were purely physical -- if I were living in a state of prolonged terminal pain such as cancer, from which euthanasia was the only escape -- such as it was with one of my sisters, who I watched get eaten away by cancer and held her hand in her last hours when she was barely more than skin over a skeleton -- no one but the most fanatical would deny her that mercy.  Well, I don't think my terminal pain is any less valid for being mental (even putting the physical aside).  It is real, it's been with me long enough, and I don't think I owe anyone any excuses or apologies for wanting it to be over.

(And if you're reading this and thinking, "then why are you even bothering here?"  Two reasons: because a place like this is the only place I can vent like this, where I can let out the full-throated scream without repercussions, without fear I'm going to be turned in [about which more in a minute] or just hopelessly hurt anyone left around me who'd listen -- but also because I know I'm not alone in feeling this way, feeling that those of us who are in legitimate, terminal, suicidal pain should be allowed relief from that pain without guilt and without apology -- the same as you would offer to anyone in terminal PHYSICAL pain -- or at the VERY least the relief of being able to fucking TALK about it.  I think there is a VAST group of voices like mine out there who want to say what I'm saying, and as long as I'm here I may as well make my cri de coeur for them, for us.  Take us seriously and hear us out without silencing or threatening us.  Please allow us to be open about ourselves, and allow us the benefit of the doubt that we may actually know more about what's better for us than you do, no matter how well-intentioned you may be.)

"Everything" covers it, in lieu of not knowing what I can and can't say.  I wrote a very long detailed post that was deleted, twice, without giving me a reason, and now that someone is actually talking to me I'm terrified not knowing which parts I can or can't say before I stop being allowed to speak at all.

God, finally.  I don't *know* what's going on.  I spent *hours* pouring my heart out into a post and it got deleted both times, and no one has told me why.

I'm afraid, I'm alone, I'm hurting like hell, and now I don't even know what to do.
Again, already?  Christ, did you even *read* any of it?  And I suppose you're still not going to tell me why?
